passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Dear OceanEx Support Team,

I am writing regarding order #58231, a shipment of patio furniture that was scheduled to arrive at our warehouse on June 3. As of today, June 9, the containers have still not been delivered, and our online tracking tool shows no updates since May 28.

This delay is beginning to affect our ability to fulfill orders for the summer season, and several customers have already contacted us to ask about their purchases. Could you please provide an updated delivery estimate and confirm whether the shipment is still in transit?
I would also appreciate knowing whether any compensation is available for the inconvenience, as this is not the first time an OceanEx shipment has been delayed this year.

Regards,
Rina Tanaka
Purchasing Manager, Brightleaf Imports

questions.question_en: Why did Ms. Tanaka write the e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 田中女士為什麼寫這封電子郵件？
options: To inquire about a delayed shipment
questions.explanation_zh: 信件一開始便說明是針對訂單 #58231 的貨物延遲送達提出詢問，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: According to the e-mail, when was the shipment originally scheduled to arrive?
questions.question_zh: 根據這封信，貨物原本預計何時送達？
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到貨物原訂於 6 月 3 日送達倉庫，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about Brightleaf Imports' relationship with OceanEx Freight?
questions.question_zh: 從信中可以推測出 Brightleaf Imports 與 OceanEx Freight 之間的關係為何？
options: It has never used OceanEx's services before
It has experienced previous delays with OceanEx
It plans to switch to a different freight company immediately
It has already received a partial refund
questions.explanation_zh: 信末提到「這已不是 OceanEx 今年第一次延誤出貨」，顯示雙方過去也曾發生類似延誤，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "fulfill" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "fulfill" 一詞意思最接近下列何者？
questions.explanation_zh: 此處 "fulfill orders" 指「完成/履行訂單」，故與 "complete" 意思最接近，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: Memo
paragraphs: This memo is to inform you that the quarterly planning meeting originally scheduled for April 18 has been moved to April 25 due to a scheduling conflict with the regional sales conference.

The meeting will still be held in Conference Room B on the third floor, but the start time has changed from 9:00 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. to accommodate staff traveling back from the conference that morning.

Please update your calendars accordingly and notify your team members of this change. If you have prepared materials for the original date, there is no need to revise them; the agenda remains the same.
Department heads who are unable to attend should send a representative and forward any discussion points to my office by April 23.

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of this memo?
questions.question_zh: 這份備忘錄的主要目的為何？
options: To cancel the quarterly planning meeting
To announce a change in the meeting's date and time
To introduce a new conference room
To request feedback on the meeting agenda
questions.explanation_zh: 備忘錄開頭即說明季度規劃會議的日期與時間已變更，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why was the meeting rescheduled?
questions.question_zh: 會議為什麼被重新安排時間？
options: It conflicted with the regional sales conference
Several department heads were on vacation
The agenda was not yet finalized
questions.explanation_zh: 備忘錄提到原訂日期與區域銷售會議衝突，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT mentioned in the memo?
questions.question_zh: 下列何者未在備忘錄中提及？
options: The new start time of the meeting
The room where the meeting will be held
A virtual attendance option for the meeting
The deadline for submitting discussion points
questions.explanation_zh: 備忘錄中提到新的開始時間、會議室、及提交討論要點的截止日，但並未提及是否可以線上參加會議，因此答案是 (C)。

passages.title: Letter

meta.label: From:
meta.value: Gregory Holt, Sales Director, Meridian Paper Supplies

meta.label: To:
meta.value: Ms. Angela Ruiz, Purchasing Dept., Westfield Print Co.

paragraphs: Dear Ms. Ruiz,

Meridian Paper Supplies values the partnership we have built with Westfield Print Co. over the past six years. I am writing to let you know that, due to a sustained increase in raw material and shipping costs, we will need to adjust our pricing structure for all bulk paper orders effective October 1.

The new price list, enclosed with this letter, reflects an average increase of 6 percent across our standard product lines. Orders placed and confirmed before September 15 will still be honored at current prices, regardless of the delivery date.
We understand that this change may affect your budgeting, and our account team is available to discuss volume discounts or alternative product options that may help offset the impact.

Sincerely,
Gregory Holt
Sales Director, Meridian Paper Supplies

questions.question_en: Why did Mr. Holt write this letter?
questions.question_zh: Holt 先生為什麼寫這封信？
options: To notify a customer of a price increase
To apologize for a shipping error
To announce a new product line
questions.explanation_zh: 信中說明由於原物料及運費成本上升，公司必須調整大宗紙張訂單的價格，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is true about orders placed before September 15?
questions.question_zh: 關於9月15日之前下的訂單，下列敘述何者正確？
options: They will still be charged at current prices
They will receive an extra discount
They will be delayed until October
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到9月15日前確認的訂單仍會以目前價格計價，不受此次調價影響，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about Westfield Print Co.?
questions.question_zh: 關於 Westfield Print Co.，可以推測出什麼？
options: It is a new customer of Meridian Paper Supplies
It has done business with Meridian for several years
It no longer purchases bulk paper
It has switched to a competitor
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到雙方合作關係已維持六年之久，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "sustained" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "sustained" 一詞意思最接近下列何者？
questions.explanation_zh: "sustained increase" 指「持續性的上漲」，語意最接近 "continuous"，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: E-mail

meta.label: Subject:
meta.value: Re: Blender Model LX-200 - Replacement Request

paragraphs: Dear Ms. Morales,
Thank you for contacting Lumina Appliances about the issue with your LX-200 blender. We are sorry to hear that the motor stopped working after only three weeks of use.

Based on the photos you sent, our technical team has confirmed that the unit is covered under our one-year warranty. We will ship a replacement blender to the address on file within five business days, free of charge. You do not need to return the defective unit; instead, please dispose of it safely, as instructed in the enclosed recycling guide.
If the replacement arrives with the same issue, please contact us directly at this email address, and we will arrange a full refund instead of a second replacement.

Best regards,
Customer Care Team, Lumina Appliances

questions.question_en: Why did Lumina Appliances send this e-mail?
questions.question_zh: Lumina Appliances 為什麼寄出這封電子郵件？
options: To advertise a new blender model
To respond to a warranty complaint
questions.explanation_zh: 信件內容是針對顧客反映果汁機故障一事所做的保固回覆，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is Ms. Morales asked to do with the defective blender?
questions.question_zh: Morales 女士被要求如何處理故障的果汁機？
options: Return it in the original packaging
Bring it to a local store
Mail it to the technical team
questions.explanation_zh: 信中說明不需退回故障機器，只需依回收指南安全丟棄即可，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What will happen if the replacement blender has the same problem?
questions.question_zh: 如果替換的果汁機出現同樣的問題，將會發生什麼事？
options: A technician will visit the customer's home
The customer will receive a full refund
The warranty period will be extended
A second replacement will be sent automatically
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到若替換品仍有相同問題，公司將改為提供全額退款，而非再次更換，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT mentioned in the e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 下列何者未在信中提及？
options: The length of the product warranty
The estimated shipping time for the replacement
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到保固期限（一年）、免費更換、以及五個工作天內送達，但並未提到退貨用的預付運送標籤，因此答案是 (D)。

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Dear Team,

This is a reminder that the annual open enrollment period for health and dental benefits will run from October 13 to October 31. During this window, all employees may enroll in a new plan, adjust their current coverage, or add dependents, regardless of whether they experienced a qualifying life event.

This year, we are introducing two new plan options through Windmere Health: a low-premium plan with a higher deductible, and a comprehensive plan with expanded vision coverage. Details on both plans are available on the benefits portal, along with a short video explaining the differences.

Employees who do not make any changes by October 31 will automatically remain on their current plan for the coming year. We strongly encourage everyone to log in and review the options, even if you plan to keep your existing coverage.
A live Q&A session with the benefits team will be held on October 20 at 2:00 p.m. in the main auditorium for anyone with questions.

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of this e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 這封電子郵件的主要目的為何？
options: To announce a change in employee salaries
To remind employees of the open enrollment period
To introduce a new HR director
To cancel dental coverage for all employees
questions.explanation_zh: 信件主要在提醒員工年度健康及牙科保險開放投保期間，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will happen to employees who make no changes by October 31?
questions.question_zh: 若員工在10月31日前未做任何變更，將會發生什麼事？
options: They will lose their current coverage
They will automatically remain on their current plan
They will be enrolled in the low-premium plan
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到若員工在10月31日前未做出任何變動，將自動保留目前方案，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: According to the e-mail, what is a feature of the new comprehensive plan?
questions.question_zh: 根據信件內容，新的「全面型」方案有什麼特色？
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到全面型方案的特色是擴大的視力保健給付範圍，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: Why might an employee attend the session on October 20?
questions.question_zh: 員工為什麼可能會參加10月20日的活動？
options: To submit enrollment forms in person
To ask questions about the benefit plans
To meet the new benefits provider's CEO
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到10月20日將舉行現場問答活動，讓員工可以針對保險方案提問，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Dear Mr. Iversen,
Thank you for your application for the Marketing Coordinator position at Sable & Finch Media. We were impressed with your portfolio and would like to invite you to an interview.

The interview is scheduled for February 19 at 2:00 p.m. and will be conducted by video call. You will meet with the marketing director, Ms. Paula Grant, and one member of the creative team. The session should last approximately 45 minutes and will include a short exercise in which you will review a sample social media campaign and offer feedback.
Please confirm your availability by replying to this email no later than February 15. If the proposed time does not work for you, we can offer an alternative slot on February 20.

Best regards,
Brookstone Recruiting on behalf of Sable & Finch Media

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 這封電子郵件的目的為何？
options: To invite a candidate to an interview
To offer a candidate a position
questions.explanation_zh: 信件主要目的是邀請 Iversen 先生參加面試，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: How will the interview be conducted?
questions.question_zh: 這場面試將以何種方式進行？
options: In person at the company office
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到面試將以視訊方式進行，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What will the interview include, according to the e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 根據信件內容，這場面試將包含什麼內容？
options: A review of a sample social media campaign
A group discussion with other candidates
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到面試將包含檢視一則社群媒體行銷活動範例並提供意見的練習，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: E-mail

meta.label: Subject:
meta.value: Venue Change - Global Retail Innovation Summit

paragraphs: Dear Attendee,

We are writing to inform you of an important change to the Global Retail Innovation Summit, taking place May 14-15. Due to unexpected renovations at the Carlton Convention Center, the summit will now be held at the Bayside Exhibition Hall, located two blocks north of the original venue.

All sessions, workshops, and meal times will remain exactly as printed in the original schedule. Parking at Bayside is limited, so we strongly encourage attendees to use public transportation or the shuttle service running from Carlton Convention Center every 20 minutes on both days.

Updated badges reflecting the new location will be available for pickup starting at 7:30 a.m. on May 14. If you have already printed your badge with the old address, please disregard it and collect a new one on-site.
We apologize for any inconvenience and look forward to seeing you at the summit.

questions.question_en: Why was this e-mail sent to attendees?
questions.question_zh: 這封電子郵件寄送給與會者的原因為何？
options: To announce a change of venue
questions.explanation_zh: 信件主要說明高峰會場地已變更，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why is the venue being changed?
questions.question_zh: 場地為什麼會變更？
options: A scheduling conflict with another event
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到原場地 Carlton Convention Center 正在進行整修，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What does the e-mail say will remain unchanged?
questions.question_zh: 信中提到什麼事項將維持不變？
options: The schedule of sessions and meals
questions.explanation_zh: 信中明確說明所有場次、工作坊及用餐時間都將維持原定行程不變，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Letter
paragraphs: Dear Customer Relations Team,

I am writing to express my disappointment with a dining table (model Everline Oak, item #7734) that I purchased from your Denton Street showroom on December 2. Within only five weeks, one of the table legs has developed a visible crack, and the surface finish has started to peel near the edges.

I have attached photographs showing the damage. Given that the table was advertised as being built for "everyday, long-term use," I do not believe this level of wear is reasonable for a product used under normal household conditions.
I would like to request either a full refund or a replacement table of the same model. I have kept the original receipt and delivery confirmation, which I can provide upon request.
I trust that Ferrow Home Goods will resolve this matter promptly, as I have been a loyal customer for several years.

Sincerely,
Thomas Blake

questions.question_en: Why did Mr. Blake write this letter?
questions.question_zh: Blake 先生為什麼寫這封信？
options: To complain about a defective product
questions.explanation_zh: 信中說明餐桌在購買五週後便出現裂痕與掉漆，Blake 先生對此提出抱怨，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: How long after the purchase did Mr. Blake notice the problem?
questions.question_zh: Blake 先生在購買後多久才發現問題？
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到僅五週後桌腳便出現裂痕，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What evidence does Mr. Blake offer to support his claim?
questions.question_zh: Blake 先生提供了什麼證據來支持他的說法？
options: A statement from a repair technician
A video recording of the defect
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到他附上了照片，並保留了收據與送貨確認單，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "peel" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "peel" 一詞意思最接近下列何者？
questions.explanation_zh: "the surface finish has started to peel" 指桌面塗層開始「剝落、脫落」，語意最接近 "separate from the surface"，因此答案是 (A)。

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Dear Team,

As previously announced, renovation work on the fourth floor will begin on August 3 and is expected to last approximately three weeks. During this period, all employees currently seated on the fourth floor will be temporarily relocated to available desks on the sixth floor.

IT will migrate your phone extensions and network connections over the weekend of August 1-2, so please save any unsaved work and log off your computers before leaving on Friday, July 31. A moving crew will transport boxes of personal items on Saturday morning; boxes should be labeled with your name and clearly marked "Fragile" if needed.

Please note that the sixth-floor pantry and printer stations will be shared with the existing sixth-floor staff, so we ask everyone to be considerate of noise levels and equipment use during this transition.
If you have large personal items that will not fit in a standard moving box, please contact facilities directly by July 25 to arrange alternative transport.

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of this e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 這封電子郵件的主要目的為何？
options: To inform staff of a temporary relocation
questions.explanation_zh: 信件主要說明四樓員工在整修期間將暫時遷移至六樓辦公，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What should employees do before leaving the office on July 31?
questions.question_zh: 員工在7月31日離開辦公室前應該做什麼？
options: Save their work and log off their computers
Label their desks with their names
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到員工應在7月31日星期五離開前儲存工作並登出電腦，以便IT團隊進行搬遷作業，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT mentioned in the e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 下列何者未在信中提及？
options: The expected duration of the renovation
Shared use of the sixth-floor pantry
questions.explanation_zh: 信中提到整修預計時程、搬遷箱標示方式、以及六樓茶水間共用事宜，但並未提到採購替代家具，因此答案是 (C)。

passages.title: Invoice
paragraphs: Please find below the itemized charges for dental supply order #30987, shipped on May 5 by Meadowlane Dental Supply Co. Payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date. A late fee of 1.5% per month will apply to overdue balances.

questions.question_en: What kind of document is this?
questions.question_zh: 這是一份什麼樣的文件？
questions.explanation_zh: 文件標題及內容皆為請款明細，屬於發票（invoice），因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is the total amount due on this invoice?
questions.question_zh: 這張發票的應付總金額為多少？

questions.question_en: According to the invoice, what happens if payment is late?
questions.question_zh: 根據發票內容，若延遲付款會發生什麼事？
options: A late fee of 1.5% per month will apply
questions.explanation_zh: 發票說明中提到逾期未繳款項將按月加收1.5%的滯納金，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: How many boxes of disposable gloves were ordered?
questions.question_zh: 訂購了幾箱拋棄式手套？
questions.explanation_zh: 根據表格，拋棄式手套（Disposable Gloves）的訂購數量為20箱，因此答案是 (C)。

passages.title: Registration Form
paragraphs: Complete the form below to register for the Northbridge Small Business Expo. Registration includes access to all exhibitor booths, two keynote sessions, and a boxed lunch on both days. Attendees who register before August 20 receive an early-bird discount of $30.

rows: One day of access, lunch included
Both days, lunch included both days
Booth space, two staff badges, listing in event guide

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this form?
questions.question_zh: 這份表格的用途為何？
options: To register for a business expo
To apply for an exhibitor loan
questions.explanation_zh: 這是一份用於報名參加 Northbridge 中小企業博覽會的表格，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: How much can attendees save by registering before August 20?
questions.question_zh: 在8月20日前完成報名的與會者可節省多少費用？
questions.explanation_zh: 文字說明8月20日前完成報名者可享有 $30 的早鳥優惠，表格中兩日票價差額也是 $30，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is included with the Exhibitor Booth registration?
questions.question_zh: 攤位（Exhibitor Booth）報名項目包含什麼？
options: Two staff badges and a listing in the event guide
Unlimited boxed lunches for one week
questions.explanation_zh: 表格中列出攤位報名包含攤位空間、兩張工作人員識別證，以及活動指南中的名錄刊登，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Order Confirmation
paragraphs: Thank you for your order. Due to current warehouse capacity, your items will be shipped in three separate batches rather than as a single delivery. Each batch will be sent via TrackFast Freight, and tracking numbers will be emailed once each shipment departs our facility.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this document?
questions.question_zh: 這份文件的目的為何？
options: To confirm an order and its shipping schedule
To file a complaint about damaged goods
questions.explanation_zh: 文件內容為確認訂單內容及分批出貨時程，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why will the order be shipped in three separate batches?
questions.question_zh: 為什麼這筆訂單將分成三批出貨？
options: Due to a shortage of chairs
Because of a shipping company strike
questions.explanation_zh: 文件中說明由於目前倉庫容量有限，因此訂單將分三批出貨，因此答案是 (A)。

questions.question_en: Which item is scheduled to ship first?
questions.question_zh: 哪一項商品預計最先出貨？
questions.explanation_zh: 根據表格，第一批出貨（3月28日）的商品是可調式辦公桌，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: How will the customer be informed once each shipment departs?
questions.question_zh: 每批貨物出貨後，顧客將如何得知相關訊息？
options: By a phone call from the sales rep
By a tracking number sent via e-mail
By a printed notice mailed to the office
By an in-person visit from the driver
questions.explanation_zh: 文件中提到每批貨物出貨後，將以電子郵件寄送追蹤號碼給顧客，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Notice
paragraphs: Please be advised that the main office will be closed on December 26 and December 29 in observance of the winter holiday period. Normal business hours will resume on December 30.

Employees who are required to work during this period due to ongoing client projects should coordinate directly with their supervisor to confirm scheduling and will receive holiday pay in accordance with company policy.

The building's front entrance will be locked during the closure, but employees with keycard access may enter the office to retrieve personal items between 9:00 a.m. and 3:00 p.m. on December 27 only. Security will be present during these hours.
All voicemail and e-mail inquiries received during the closure will be answered within two business days of reopening on December 30.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this notice?
questions.question_zh: 這則公告的目的為何？
options: To announce new office hours permanently
To inform staff of office closure dates
To request volunteers for holiday work
To announce a change in company policy
questions.explanation_zh: 公告主要說明辦公室將於特定日期關閉，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: When will normal business hours resume?
questions.question_zh: 正常上班時間將於何時恢復？
questions.explanation_zh: 公告提到正常營業時間將於12月30日恢復，因此答案是 (D)。

questions.question_en: On what day can employees retrieve personal items from the office?
questions.question_zh: 員工可以在哪一天回辦公室拿取個人物品？
questions.explanation_zh: 公告說明員工可於12月27日上午9點至下午3點期間憑門禁卡進入辦公室拿取個人物品，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will employees who work during the closure period receive?
questions.question_zh: 在辦公室關閉期間仍需工作的員工將獲得什麼？
options: Holiday pay according to company policy
questions.explanation_zh: 公告提到在此期間需要工作的員工將依公司政策獲得假日津貼，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Notice
paragraphs: Effective July 1, the company's travel expense reimbursement policy will be updated. Employees will now be required to submit all receipts through the new digital expense portal, EasyClaim, rather than emailing scanned copies to the finance department.

The maximum daily meal allowance for domestic travel will increase from $45 to $55, and reimbursement requests must be submitted within 14 days of the trip's end date, rather than the current 30-day window.
Employees who have travel scheduled before July 1 should continue to use the current process for that trip. Any trip beginning on or after July 1 must follow the new procedure in full.
Training sessions on how to use the EasyClaim portal will be held on June 24 and June 26; attendance is optional but strongly recommended.

questions.question_en: What is this notice mainly about?
questions.question_zh: 這則公告主要在說明什麼？
options: A change in employee vacation policy
An update to the travel expense reimbursement policy
questions.explanation_zh: 公告主要說明差旅報帳政策的更新，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is the new daily meal allowance for domestic travel?
questions.question_zh: 國內出差新的每日餐費上限為多少？
questions.explanation_zh: 公告提到每日餐費上限將從45美元調高至55美元，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: According to the notice, how soon must reimbursement requests be submitted after a trip ends?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告，出差結束後多久之內必須提交報帳申請？
questions.explanation_zh: 公告提到新規定要求出差結束後14天內提交報帳申請，較原本30天縮短，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Notice
paragraphs: This notice is to inform all tenants of Riverside Business Tower that the building's water supply will be shut off on October 10 from 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. the following morning while contractors replace aging pipes on the lower floors.

Restrooms on floors 1 through 5 will be unavailable during this time; restrooms on floors 6 and above will not be affected, as they are connected to a separate water line. Tenants are advised to store drinking water in advance if they plan to be in the building after hours.
The elevators will remain in operation throughout the maintenance work, though elevator 2 will be reserved exclusively for contractor use starting at 8:00 p.m.
We apologize for any inconvenience and thank you for your patience as we complete these necessary upgrades.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this notice?
questions.question_zh: 這則公告的目的為何？
options: To inform tenants of a scheduled water shutoff
To advertise a new tenant amenity
To announce a change in elevator hours
questions.explanation_zh: 公告主要通知房客大樓將進行停水維修工程，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: What time will the water supply be restored?
questions.question_zh: 供水將於幾點恢復？
questions.explanation_zh: 公告提到停水時間為晚上10點至隔天早上6點，因此供水將於早上6點恢復，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: Which restrooms will NOT be affected by the water shutoff?
questions.question_zh: 哪些樓層的洗手間不會受到停水影響？
questions.explanation_zh: 公告說明六樓以上的洗手間因使用獨立水管線路，不受此次停水影響，因此答案是 (C)。

questions.question_en: What will happen to elevator 2 starting at 8:00 p.m.?
questions.question_zh: 晚上8點起，2號電梯將會如何？
options: It will be shut down for the night
It will be reserved for contractor use
It will be moved to a different floor
It will operate at a slower speed
questions.explanation_zh: 公告提到2號電梯自晚上8點起將保留給承包商專用，因此答案是 (B)。

passages.title: Advertisement
paragraphs: Comfort Line Furnishings Presents: The Meridian Task Chair

Designed by ergonomics specialists, the Meridian Task Chair features adjustable lumbar support, a breathable mesh back, and armrests that move in four directions to fit any desk height. Customers who purchase between September 1 and September 30 will receive a five-year warranty at no extra charge, a $150 value.

The Meridian is available in six colors and ships fully assembled. Order online at comfortline.com or visit one of our twelve showrooms nationwide. Mention code MERIDIAN10 to receive an additional 10% discount on your first order.
For bulk orders of ten chairs or more, contact our corporate sales team at sales@comfortline.com for special pricing.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the advertisement?

To promote a new office chair and a limited-time offer
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告主要在介紹 Meridian Task Chair 新品，並說明九月份的限時優惠方案，因此答案是 (B)。

questions.question_en: According to the advertisement, what will customers receive if they purchase a Meridian Task Chair in September?
questions.question_zh: 根據廣告內容，顧客若在九月購買 Meridian Task Chair 會獲得什麼？
options: A five-year warranty at no extra cost
A discount on future purchases only

A contact method for bulk orders

passages.title: Job Posting
paragraphs: Brightwave Beverages is seeking a Marketing Coordinator to join our growing team. The successful candidate will assist in planning product launches, coordinating with retail partners, and analyzing sales data to identify emerging trends.

Requirements include a bachelor's degree in marketing or a related field, at least two years of experience in consumer goods marketing, and strong written communication skills. Familiarity with social media analytics tools is preferred but not required.

This is a full-time position offering a competitive salary, health benefits, and opportunities for advancement within the company. Brightwave Beverages was founded in 2015 and now distributes sparkling water products to over 500 retailers across the Pacific Northwest.
Interested applicants should submit a resume and cover letter to careers@brightwavebev.com by September 20. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this posting?

To advertise a job opening at a beverage company
To introduce a new product line
questions.explanation_zh: 這是一則徵才公告，說明 Brightwave Beverages 正在招募行銷專員，故答案為 (B)。

questions.question_en: According to the posting, which of the following is required of applicants?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告，應徵者需具備以下哪一項條件？
options: At least five years of experience
At least two years of consumer goods marketing experience
questions.explanation_zh: 文中提到應徵者需具備至少兩年消費性商品行銷經驗，故答案為 (C)。

questions.question_en: How should interested applicants apply for the position?

options: Submit a resume and cover letter by email

passages.title: Advertisement
paragraphs: The Northbridge Technology Summit Returns This November

Join more than 3,000 professionals from the software, hardware, and telecommunications industries at the Northbridge Technology Summit, taking place November 10-12 at the Kingsford Convention Center. This year's summit features keynote speakers from leading firms, forty breakout sessions, and a dedicated exhibition hall showcasing the newest innovations in artificial intelligence and cloud computing.

Early-bird registration, available until October 1, is priced at $399 and includes access to all sessions, a welcome reception, and a printed program guide. Registration after October 1 rises to $549. Students with a valid ID may attend for $149 at any time.
Group discounts of 15% are available for companies registering five or more employees. Visit northbridgesummit.com to reserve your spot, as space in several sessions is limited.

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of this advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告的主要目的是什麼？
options: To promote registration for a technology conference
To announce a change in conference dates
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告主要目的是宣傳 Northbridge Technology Summit 的報名活動，故答案為 (A)。

questions.question_en: How much does early-bird registration cost before October 1?
questions.question_zh: 10 月 1 日前的早鳥註冊費是多少？
questions.explanation_zh: 文中提到 10/1 前的早鳥註冊費為 399 美元，故答案為 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why would attendees benefit from registering before October 1?

options: They would receive a free printed book
They would pay a lower registration fee
They would be guaranteed a keynote speaking slot
questions.explanation_zh: 文中指出 10 月 1 日後註冊費將調漲至 549 美元，因此提早註冊可享較低費用，故答案為 (B)。

questions.question_en: The word "reserve" in the last paragraph is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 最後一段中的 "reserve" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思？
questions.explanation_zh: "reserve" 在此處意指「預訂／確保」座位，與 secure 意思最接近，故答案為 (C)。

passages.title: Advertisement
paragraphs: Prime Office Space Available — Riverside Business Park

A 2,400-square-foot office suite is now available for lease on the third floor of Riverside Business Park, located at 220 Harbor Road. The space includes four private offices, an open work area suitable for up to fifteen desks, a conference room, and a small kitchen. Large windows on two sides provide abundant natural light.

Monthly rent is $3,800, which includes utilities, high-speed internet, and access to the building's shared parking garage. A minimum lease term of two years is required, and the first month's rent plus a security deposit equal to one month's rent are due upon signing.

The building is a five-minute walk from the Harbor Road transit station and is close to several restaurants and a fitness center. To schedule a viewing, contact property manager Diane Ruiz at (555) 203-4471.

questions.question_en: What is being advertised?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告在宣傳什麼？
options: An office space available for lease
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告內容說明位於 Riverside Business Park 的辦公室套房招租，故答案為 (A)。

questions.question_en: What is included in the monthly rent?
questions.question_zh: 每月租金包含什麼？
options: Utilities, internet, and parking garage access

questions.question_en: What is required when signing the lease?
questions.question_zh: 簽約時需要支付什麼？
options: The first month's rent and a security deposit
A personal guarantee from the business owner
Proof of five years in business
questions.explanation_zh: 文中說明簽約時需支付第一個月租金及一個月租金的押金，故答案為 (B)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about the location of the office space?
questions.question_zh: 關於這個辦公空間的地點，可以推論出什麼？
options: It is difficult to reach by public transportation
It is conveniently located near transit and amenities
It is located far from any restaurants
It has no nearby parking options
questions.explanation_zh: 文中提到該大樓步行五分鐘即可到達捷運站，且鄰近餐廳與健身中心，顯示地點便利，故答案為 (B)。

passages.title: Advertisement
paragraphs: Oakhaven Home Goods — Autumn Clearance Event

Solid oak dining tables, starting at $499, are now on sale during our Autumn Clearance Event, running October 5 through October 19. Each table is handcrafted from sustainably sourced oak and seats up to eight guests. Matching chairs are sold separately and are also discounted by 25% during the sale period.

All furniture purchased during the clearance event includes free delivery within 50 miles of our Cedar Falls warehouse. Orders outside this radius will incur a delivery fee based on distance. Assembly service is available for an additional $75.
Visit our showroom at 12 Millbrook Lane, Cedar Falls, or shop the full collection at oakhavenhome.com. Because inventory is limited, we recommend placing orders early to avoid disappointment.

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: 這則廣告的主要目的是什麼？
options: To promote a seasonal furniture sale
To introduce a new delivery partner
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告主要在宣傳 Oakhaven Home Goods 的秋季清倉特賣活動，故答案為 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is included with furniture purchased during the clearance event?
questions.question_zh: 在清倉活動期間購買家具可獲得什麼？
options: Free delivery within 50 miles of the warehouse
A gift card for future purchases

questions.question_en: What is NOT mentioned in the advertisement?

questions.question_en: The word "sustainably" in the first paragraph is closest in meaning to

passages.title: Job Posting
paragraphs: Lakeside Bistro, a farm-to-table restaurant overlooking Miller Lake, is hiring an experienced Sous Chef to support our Executive Chef in daily kitchen operations. Responsibilities include supervising kitchen staff, maintaining food safety standards, and helping design seasonal menus using locally sourced ingredients.

Candidates should have at least three years of experience in a professional kitchen, preferably in a fine-dining setting, and must be available to work evenings and weekends. Culinary school training is a plus but not mandatory for candidates with strong hands-on experience.

We offer a starting salary of $52,000 per year, staff meals, and paid vacation after six months of employment. Lakeside Bistro has been a Millbrook favorite since 2018 and was recently featured in Regional Dining Magazine.
To apply, email your resume to hiring@lakesidebistro.com or stop by in person between 2 and 4 p.m., Tuesday through Friday.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this job posting?

options: To announce a new restaurant menu
To advertise an open Sous Chef position
To promote a restaurant's grand opening
To announce a change in restaurant ownership
questions.explanation_zh: 這是一則徵才公告，說明 Lakeside Bistro 正在招募副主廚，故答案為 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is required of candidates for this position?
questions.question_zh: 應徵此職位需具備什麼條件？
options: At least three years of professional kitchen experience
questions.explanation_zh: 文中提到應徵者須具備至少三年專業廚房經驗，烹飪學校訓練則非必要條件，故答案為 (B)。

passages.title: Advertisement
paragraphs: An Evening for the Arts — Annual Fundraising Gala

The Millfield Arts Council invites the community to An Evening for the Arts, a fundraising gala to be held Saturday, October 24, at the Grand Pavilion Hotel. Proceeds from the event will support music and art education programs in local public schools.

The evening includes a three-course dinner, a silent auction featuring works donated by regional artists, and a live performance by the Millfield Chamber Orchestra. Doors open at 6:30 p.m., with dinner service beginning at 7:15 p.m.

Individual tickets are $125, and tables of ten may be reserved for $1,100, a savings of $150. Business sponsorships starting at $2,500 include a table for ten as well as recognition in the event program and on the Arts Council website.
Tickets can be purchased at millfieldarts.org/gala or by calling the Arts Council office at (555) 340-8821. Seating is limited, and the event sold out last year.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of the event described in the advertisement?

options: To raise funds for arts education programs
To promote a new orchestra recording
questions.explanation_zh: 廣告說明此活動所得將用於支持地方學校的音樂與藝術教育計畫，故答案為 (B)。

questions.question_en: How much can a table of ten be reserved for, and what is the savings compared to individual tickets?

A private meeting with the orchestra
A discount on next year's gala
questions.explanation_zh: 文中說明 2,500 美元起的企業贊助包含十人桌及在節目單與網站上的致謝，故答案為 (A)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred from the advertisement?

passages.title: Advertisement
paragraphs: Now Leasing: Cypress Court Apartments

Cypress Court Apartments, a newly renovated community in the Fairview neighborhood, is now leasing one- and two-bedroom units. One-bedroom apartments start at $1,150 per month, and two-bedroom units start at $1,450. All units include stainless steel appliances, in-unit washer and dryer, and a private balcony.
Residents enjoy access to a rooftop lounge, a fitness center open 24 hours, and a secure package room. A limited number of covered parking spaces are available for an additional $60 per month.

It is located far from any schools

passages.title: Press Release
paragraphs: Sterling Analytics Announces Acquisition of DataForge Inc.

CHICAGO — Sterling Analytics, a leading provider of business intelligence software, today announced it has completed its acquisition of DataForge Inc., a data visualization startup based in Austin, Texas. The acquisition, valued at $45 million, is expected to strengthen Sterling Analytics' product suite by adding DataForge's advanced charting and dashboard tools.

"This acquisition allows us to offer our customers a more complete analytics platform," said Sterling Analytics CEO Priya Raman. "DataForge's technology and talented team will accelerate our product roadmap significantly."

All 60 DataForge employees will join Sterling Analytics and continue working from the Austin office, which will become Sterling Analytics' second headquarters. The combined company will serve more than 2,000 corporate clients worldwide.
Sterling Analytics expects to integrate DataForge's tools into its main platform by the first quarter of next year.

questions.explanation_zh: 新聞稿主要宣布 Sterling Analytics 收購 DataForge Inc. 的消息，故答案為 (A)。

questions.question_en: How much was the acquisition valued at?

questions.explanation_zh: 文中提到此次收購價值為 4,500 萬美元，故答案為 (C)。

questions.question_en: What will happen to DataForge's employees?
questions.question_zh: DataForge 的員工將會如何？
options: They will join Sterling Analytics and stay in Austin

questions.question_en: The word "accelerate" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to

questions.explanation_zh: "accelerate" 意指「加快、加速」，與 speed up 意思最接近，故答案為 (B)。

passages.title: Press Release
paragraphs: Harborview Marketplace to Celebrate Grand Opening Saturday

NEWPORT — Harborview Marketplace, a new indoor food hall featuring twelve local vendors, will celebrate its grand opening this Saturday, September 12, at 10 a.m. The 25,000-square-foot facility, located at the site of the former Newport Cannery, took eighteen months to renovate.

Visitors to the opening celebration will enjoy live music, free samples from participating vendors, and a ribbon-cutting ceremony with Mayor Elena Cortez at 10:30 a.m. The first 200 guests will receive a reusable Harborview Marketplace tote bag.

Harborview Marketplace will operate daily from 11 a.m. to 9 p.m. and will feature a rotating lineup of guest vendors on weekends. Developer Tom Whitfield said the project is intended to revitalize the waterfront district and create roughly 80 new jobs in the community.
Parking is available in the adjacent structure at 15 Wharf Street, with the first two hours free for marketplace visitors.

passages.title: Public Notice
paragraphs: Notice of Temporary Bus Route Changes — Route 14

The Cascade Regional Transit Authority announces that Route 14 will be temporarily rerouted beginning September 15 due to bridge maintenance on Fifth Avenue. The closure is expected to last approximately six weeks, through October 27.

During this period, Route 14 buses will detour via Grant Street and Union Avenue, bypassing the Fifth Avenue and Cedar Street stops. Riders who normally board at these stops should use the temporary stop located at the corner of Grant Street and Third Avenue, approximately two blocks from the original location.

All other Route 14 stops will continue to operate on their regular schedule, and no change in service frequency is planned. Riders are encouraged to allow extra travel time, as the detour may add five to ten minutes to the normal route.
For up-to-date information, riders can check the Cascade Regional Transit Authority website or call the customer service line at (555) 812-3300.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this notice?

To inform riders of a temporary bus route change
To announce a new bus line
questions.explanation_zh: 公告主要說明 Route 14 因橋樑維修而暫時改道，故答案為 (B)。

questions.question_en: Why is Route 14 being rerouted?

questions.explanation_zh: 文中說明因第五大道橋樑進行維修工程，故公車路線暫時改道，答案為 (B)。

questions.question_en: What is NOT mentioned as a result of the detour?

options: The expected duration of the closure
questions.explanation_zh: 文中特別說明服務班次不會改變，因此「服務頻率的改變」並未被提及作為改道的結果，故答案為 (A)。

passages.title: Company Announcement
paragraphs: Ferncrest Industries Names New Chief Executive Officer

Ferncrest Industries, a manufacturer of industrial packaging equipment, announced today that its board of directors has appointed Marcus Webb as the company's new Chief Executive Officer, effective October 1. Webb succeeds longtime CEO Helen Ashby, who will remain with the company as a senior advisor through the end of the year.

Webb joins Ferncrest Industries after eight years as Chief Operating Officer at Redstone Manufacturing, where he oversaw a major expansion of production capacity. He holds a degree in mechanical engineering and has spent more than twenty years in the industrial equipment sector.
"Marcus brings deep operational expertise and a proven record of growth," said board chair Nathan Ellis. "We are confident he will lead Ferncrest into its next phase of expansion."
Ferncrest Industries, founded in 1978, employs approximately 1,200 people across three manufacturing facilities in the Midwest.

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of this announcement?
questions.question_zh: 這則公告的主要目的是什麼？
options: To announce a new company policy
To announce the appointment of a new CEO
questions.explanation_zh: 公告主要宣布 Ferncrest Industries 任命新任執行長 Marcus Webb，故答案為 (B)。

questions.question_en: What will happen to former CEO Helen Ashby?
questions.question_zh: 前任執行長 Helen Ashby 之後將如何？
options: She will retire immediately with no further role
She will remain as a senior advisor through the end of the year
She will become chair of the board
She will join a competing company
questions.explanation_zh: 文中提到 Ashby 將留任資深顧問至年底，故答案為 (B)。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about why the board selected Marcus Webb?
questions.question_zh: 關於董事會為何選擇 Marcus Webb，可以推論出什麼？
options: He is a longtime employee of Ferncrest Industries
He has strong operational experience and a record of growth
He was the only applicant for the position
He previously served on Ferncrest's board
questions.explanation_zh: 董事長表示 Webb 具備深厚的營運專業與成長紀錄，顯示這是他獲選的原因，故答案為 (B)。

passages.title: Public Notice
paragraphs: Public Notice: Maple Street Closure for Water Main Replacement

The City of Brookfield Department of Public Works will close Maple Street between Elm Avenue and Fourth Street beginning Monday, September 21, to replace an aging water main. The closure is expected to remain in effect for approximately three weeks, weather permitting.

During construction, local traffic will be detoured along Elm Avenue and Fifth Street. Pedestrian access to businesses along Maple Street will be maintained at all times, though sidewalks on the north side of the street will be temporarily narrowed.

Residents on the affected block should expect brief water service interruptions on September 23 and September 24 between 9 a.m. and 3 p.m. while crews connect the new pipeline. The Department of Public Works will distribute a written notice to affected households at least 48 hours before any planned interruption.
Questions about the project may be directed to the Department of Public Works at (555) 902-6600 or publicworks@brookfieldcity.gov.

questions.question_en: What is the purpose of this notice?
questions.question_zh: 這則公告的目的是什麼？
options: To inform residents of a road closure for water main work
To announce a new traffic law
To announce a public holiday schedule
questions.explanation_zh: 公告主要通知居民 Maple Street 將因更換水管工程而封閉，故答案為 (A)。

questions.question_en: How long is the closure expected to last?
questions.question_zh: 封閉期間預計持續多久？
questions.explanation_zh: 文中提到封閉期間預計約三週，視天候狀況而定，故答案為 (B)。

questions.question_en: When should residents expect brief water service interruptions?
questions.question_zh: 居民應預期在何時會有短暫停水？
questions.explanation_zh: 文中提到 9 月 23 日與 24 日上午 9 點到下午 3 點將有短暫停水，故答案為 (B)。

passages.title: Press Release
paragraphs: Vantage Robotics Wins Innovation Award for Warehouse Assistant Robot

DENVER — Vantage Robotics announced that its warehouse automation system, the PathMate, has received the National Manufacturing Innovation Award, recognizing the most significant advancement in industrial automation this year. The award was presented at the annual Manufacturing Futures Conference held last week in Denver.

The PathMate is an autonomous robot designed to transport goods within warehouses, navigating around obstacles using onboard sensors rather than fixed tracks. Since its release last year, the PathMate has been adopted by more than 150 warehouses across North America, reducing manual transport time by an average of 30 percent, according to company data.

"This recognition reflects years of research into making warehouse automation more flexible and affordable for mid-sized businesses," said Vantage Robotics founder Lisa Chen. The company plans to release an updated version of the PathMate with expanded carrying capacity early next year.
Vantage Robotics was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado.

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of this press release?
questions.question_zh: 這篇新聞稿的主要目的是什麼？
options: To announce an award won by a company's product
To announce a change in company leadership
To announce a merger with another firm
questions.explanation_zh: 新聞稿主要宣布 Vantage Robotics 的 PathMate 產品獲得國家製造創新獎，故答案為 (B)。

questions.question_en: By how much has the PathMate reduced manual transport time on average, according to the release?
questions.question_zh: 根據新聞稿，PathMate 平均減少了多少人工搬運時間？

questions.question_en: The word "adopted" in paragraph 2 is closest in meaning to
questions.question_zh: 第二段中的 "adopted" 一詞最接近下列何者的意思？
questions.explanation_zh: "adopted" 在此指「採用、導入使用」，與 put into use 意思最接近，故答案為 (C)。

passages.title: Company Announcement
paragraphs: Talbridge Consulting to Relocate Headquarters Next Month

Talbridge Consulting announced that it will relocate its corporate headquarters from downtown Ashford to the newly built Meridian Tower in the city's east district, effective October 15. The move comes as the company's workforce has grown by nearly 40 percent over the past two years.

The new headquarters will occupy three full floors of Meridian Tower and include expanded meeting spaces, a larger training center, and a dedicated client reception area. The company's current Ashford office lease expires at the end of October.

"Our current space simply can't accommodate our growth," said Talbridge Consulting managing partner Renee Okafor. "The new location gives us room to expand while staying close to our downtown client base."

All client meetings scheduled after October 15 will automatically take place at the new address. Employees will begin working from Meridian Tower starting October 13 to allow time to settle in before the first client meetings.
Talbridge Consulting's phone numbers and email addresses will remain unchanged.

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of this announcement?
questions.question_zh: 這則公告的主要目的是什麼？
options: To announce a company's office relocation
To announce a new client contract
To announce a change in phone numbers
questions.explanation_zh: 公告主要說明 Talbridge Consulting 即將搬遷總部，故答案為 (A)。

Its workforce has grown and needs more space

It is closing its downtown office permanently
questions.explanation_zh: 文中提到公司員工人數兩年內成長近 40%，現有辦公空間已不敷使用，故答案為 (B)。

questions.explanation_zh: 文中明確說明公司電話號碼與電子郵件地址將維持不變，故答案為 (B)。

passages.title: Job Posting
paragraphs: Brightleaf Design Studio, an award-winning branding agency, is looking for a Junior Graphic Designer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate has at least one year of experience with Adobe Illustrator and InDesign and a strong eye for typography.

Responsibilities include creating logo concepts, preparing print-ready files, and assisting senior designers with client presentations. This is a full-time, on-site position with occasional remote work on Fridays.

Interested applicants should send a résumé, a link to an online portfolio, and a cover letter to hiring@brightleafdesign.com by September 18. Please note that portfolio samples are required; applications without one will not be considered.

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Graphic Designer position advertised on your website. I recently completed a two-year diploma in visual communication and spent the past fourteen months as a design intern at a local print shop, where I worked extensively with Illustrator and InDesign.

I have attached my résumé along with a link to my online portfolio, which includes several logo concepts and a full brand identity package I developed for a nonprofit client. I am comfortable working on-site and would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my typography skills could contribute to your team.

I understand the position occasionally allows remote work, and I wanted to mention that I am also available to come in on Fridays if that would be more convenient for the team during my first few months.
Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to hearing from you.
Sincerely, Priya Anand

questions.question_en: What software skill does the job posting require?

questions.question_en: What does the job posting say applications must include to be considered?

questions.explanation_zh: Priya 在信中提到她過去十四個月擔任當地印刷店的設計實習生。

questions.question_en: What does Priya's portfolio include, according to her e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 根據信件內容，Priya 的作品集包含什麼？
options: A brand identity package for a nonprofit
questions.explanation_zh: Priya 提到她的作品集包含為一個非營利組織客戶設計的完整品牌識別系統。

questions.question_en: What can be inferred by comparing the job posting and Priya's e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 比對職缺公告與 Priya 的信件，可以推論出什麼？
options: She plans to decline the position because it requires on-site work.
She is unaware that the position involves any in-office work.
She directly addressed the Friday remote-work detail mentioned in the posting.

questions.question_en: Based on both documents, why is Priya's application likely to meet the posting's minimum requirement?
questions.question_zh: 根據兩篇文件，為什麼 Priya 的申請可能符合公告的最低資格要求？
options: Her 14-month internship using Illustrator and InDesign exceeds the one-year requirement.
She has a graduate degree in fine arts.
She previously worked at Brightleaf Design Studio.
She submitted her application after the September 18 deadline.
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件：公告要求至少一年 Illustrator 與 InDesign 經驗，而 Priya 的信中提到她有十四個月相關實習經驗，已超過此門檻。

passages.title: Invoice
paragraphs: Total due: $645.00. Payment terms: Net 30 from invoice date. Please remit payment to accounts@coastalofficesupplies.com or mail a check to our Tacoma office.

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Dear Coastal Office Supplies Accounts Team,

I am reviewing Invoice CO-4471 and noticed a discrepancy. Our purchase order clearly requested three toner cartridges, not four, yet the invoice charges us for four units at $45.00 each. Our warehouse log also confirms that only three cartridges arrived on August 3.
Could you please issue a corrected invoice reflecting three toner cartridges instead of four? Based on my calculation, this should reduce our total due from $645.00 to $600.00.
Also, I recall that orders over $500 qualify for free shipping. Since our corrected total will still exceed $500, could the $25.00 shipping charge be waived as well?
I would appreciate a revised invoice before our payment is due. Thank you for your prompt attention to this matter.
Best regards, Marcus Ide, Delridge Marketing Group

questions.question_en: What is the payment term stated on the invoice?

questions.explanation_zh: 發票註明付款條件為開立日起 30 天內付款（Net 30）。

questions.question_en: According to the invoice, how much was charged for shipping and handling?

questions.question_en: According to the e-mail, what discrepancy did Marcus Ide find on the invoice?
questions.question_zh: 根據信件內容，Marcus Ide 在發票上發現了什麼問題？

The invoice was sent to the wrong email address.
The invoice omitted the copy paper charge entirely.

questions.question_en: What does Marcus Ide ask Coastal Office Supplies to do in addition to correcting the toner charge?

options: Provide a discount on future orders
questions.explanation_zh: Marcus 提到，若更正後總金額仍超過 $500，希望能一併免除運費。

questions.question_en: Based on the invoice and the e-mail, what should the corrected total be if Coastal Office Supplies accepts both of Marcus Ide's requests?
questions.question_zh: 根據發票與信件內容，若 Coastal Office Supplies 同意 Marcus Ide 的兩項要求，更正後的總金額應為多少？

questions.question_en: What can be inferred by comparing the invoice's free-shipping policy note and Marcus Ide's e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 比對發票上的免運政策說明與 Marcus Ide 的信件，可以推論出什麼？
options: Marcus is unaware of the store's shipping policy.
Marcus references the invoice's own free-shipping policy to justify waiving the fee.
Marcus believes the policy no longer applies to his account.
Marcus is requesting a policy that was not mentioned anywhere in the invoice.
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩份文件：發票註明訂單超過 $500 可享免運，Marcus 在信中引用此政策來要求免除運費。

passages.title: Company Notice
paragraphs: Effective November 1, Vantage Consulting Group will update its remote work policy. Employees may work remotely up to two days per week, provided they submit a schedule to their manager by the Thursday of the previous week.
Employees whose roles require regular client-facing meetings must remain available for on-site meetings with 24 hours' notice, regardless of their remote schedule.

All remote workdays must be logged in the WorkTrack system by 10:00 a.m. on the day they occur. Employees who fail to log three or more remote days in a calendar month may have their remote privileges suspended for the following month.
Questions about the policy should be directed to hr@vantageconsulting.com.

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Hello HR Team,

Thank you for the notice about the updated remote work policy. As a client account manager, I often meet with clients on short notice, and I want to make sure I understand how this fits with the new two-day remote allowance.

If a client requests an in-person meeting on a day I had scheduled as remote, am I required to come into the office, or can the meeting be rescheduled instead? Also, could you clarify whether logging a remote day after 10:00 a.m. counts toward the three-day limit, or is the entry simply rejected by the system?
I want to plan my schedule carefully so that I don't accidentally lose my remote privileges next month.
Thank you, Renata Ford, Client Accounts

questions.question_en: By when must employees submit their remote work schedule, according to the notice?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告，員工必須在何時之前提交遠距工作排程？

The Thursday of the previous week
The first day of each month

questions.question_en: What must client-facing employees be prepared to do, according to the notice?

options: Be available for on-site meetings with 24 hours' notice
Attend a mandatory weekly training session
questions.explanation_zh: 公告提到，需經常與客戶面對面接洽的員工，即使當天排定遠距工作，仍須在接獲 24 小時通知後到公司開會。

questions.question_en: What happens if an employee fails to log three or more remote days in a calendar month, according to the notice?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告，若員工當月未登錄三天以上的遠距工作紀錄，會發生什麼事？

Their remote privileges may be suspended for the following month
They must attend a disciplinary meeting
questions.explanation_zh: 公告說明未確實登錄三天以上遠距紀錄的員工，下個月的遠距工作權利可能會被暫停。

questions.question_en: Why is Renata unsure how the new policy applies to her, according to her e-mail?

options: She works part-time and the policy only covers full-time staff.
As a client account manager, she often meets clients on short notice.
She recently transferred from another department.
She does not have access to the WorkTrack system.
questions.explanation_zh: Renata 在信中說明，身為客戶客戶經理，她經常需臨時安排客戶會議，因此想釐清政策如何適用於她的情況。

questions.question_en: Based on the notice and Renata's e-mail, why does Renata mention her job title in her message?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告與 Renata 的信件，她為什麼在信中提到自己的職稱？

To explain why the 24-hour on-site rule mentioned in the notice may conflict with her remote schedule
To complain that she was not informed about the policy

questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件：公告規定客戶接觸型員工須配合 24 小時到公司開會的規定，Renata 說明自己的職稱正是這類角色，因此想釐清此規定與遠距排程的衝突。

questions.question_en: What is Renata most likely trying to avoid, based on both documents?

options: Losing her job title as client account manager
Having her remote-work privileges suspended for improperly logged days
Missing the November 1 policy start date
Being asked to work six days a week
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件：公告提到未正確登錄遠距天數者可能被暫停遠距權利，Renata 希望事先釐清規則以妥善安排行程，避免違反登錄規定。

passages.title: Press Release
paragraphs: Harborview Books & Café will celebrate its grand opening on May 15 at 220 Pier Street. The store combines a curated selection of new and used books with a full-service café offering coffee, pastries, and light lunch items.

To mark the occasion, Harborview will offer a 20% discount on all books purchased during opening week, May 15 through May 21. The café will also host a free poetry reading every Saturday afternoon starting May 16.

Owner Elena Vasquez said, 'We wanted to create a space where people could browse a great book and enjoy a proper cup of coffee without having to go to two different places.' Harborview Books & Café will be open daily from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m.

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Dear Harborview Books & Café,

I visited your store this afternoon, on your grand opening day, hoping to take advantage of the advertised 20% discount on books. However, the cashier told me the discount would not begin until May 16, not May 15 as stated in the announcement I read online.

I also waited over twenty minutes for a coffee at the café counter, which was quite short-staffed for an opening day crowd. I understand opening days can be hectic, but I wanted to bring the discount date discrepancy to your attention, since I ended up paying full price for three books.

I still think the store has wonderful potential, and I plan to return for one of the Saturday poetry readings. I would just appreciate clarification on the discount dates, and possibly a partial refund for today's purchase.

questions.question_en: What event does the press release say will occur every Saturday?

questions.question_en: What problem did Owen Baptiste encounter regarding the discount, according to his e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 根據信件內容，Owen Baptiste 在折扣方面遇到了什麼問題？
options: The cashier said the discount would not begin until May 16, not May 15 as advertised.
The discount only applied to café items, not books.
The store had run out of discount coupons.
The discount required a minimum purchase he did not meet.
questions.explanation_zh: Owen 在信中提到，收銀員告知折扣從 5 月 16 日才開始，而非他所看到公告的 5 月 15 日。

questions.question_en: What other complaint does Owen mention in his e-mail?

options: He waited over twenty minutes for coffee due to short staffing

The discount's actual start date at the store did not match the date announced in the press release.
The poetry readings were cancelled entirely.
The café menu differed completely from what was advertised.

He plans to attend one of the Saturday poetry readings mentioned in the press release.
He plans to open a competing bookstore.
He wants a full refund for all future purchases.

passages.title: Shipping Schedule

We are writing to inform you of a delay affecting Shipment MF-8823. The truck carrying your 40 pallets of plumbing fixtures experienced a mechanical issue at the Kansas City Transfer Station and is currently undergoing repair.

Sincerely, Meridian Freight Dispatch Team

questions.question_en: What caused the delay, according to the e-mail?

questions.question_en: Based on the schedule and the e-mail, how many days later than originally planned will the shipment now arrive?

questions.question_en: What detail is mentioned in both the shipping schedule and the delay e-mail?

The website for tracking the shipment using its shipment number
The name of the truck driver
The total weight of the cargo

passages.title: Advertisement
paragraphs: Unleash your creativity with PixelForge Suite, an all-in-one photo editing and graphic design application built for beginners and professionals alike. Choose from over 500 templates, remove backgrounds in one click, and export directly to social media.
Subscribe monthly for $9.99, or save 25% with an annual plan at $89 per year. New subscribers receive a 14-day free trial, no credit card required.
PixelForge Suite is available on Windows, macOS, and iPad. Visit www.pixelforgesoftware.com to start your free trial today.

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Hello PixelForge Support,
I saw your advertisement mentioning a 14-day free trial with no credit card required, and I'm interested in trying PixelForge Suite before committing to the annual plan.

My question is: if I start the free trial and decide to subscribe to the annual plan before the trial ends, will I still be charged the full $89, or is there a prorated discount for the days already used during the trial?
Also, I mainly work on an iPad. Does the iPad version include all the same features as the desktop version, such as the one-click background removal?
Thank you for your help. I look forward to trying PixelForge Suite.
Best, Tobias Lin

Whether he'll be charged the full $89 or receive a prorated discount if he upgrades before the trial ends
Whether the monthly plan can be paid in installments
Whether refunds are available after one year

questions.question_en: What can be inferred by comparing the advertisement and Tobias's e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 比對廣告與 Tobias 的信件，可以推論出什麼？
options: Tobias will be charged automatically when the trial begins.
Tobias can wait until the trial ends without being charged, since no card is required to start it.
Tobias is not eligible for the free trial because he owns an iPad.
Tobias must pay the monthly rate before switching to annual.
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件：廣告說明開始試用不需信用卡，這表示 Tobias 可以在整個試用期間都不被扣款，直到他自行決定訂閱。

questions.question_en: Which platform does Tobias primarily use, and how does this relate to the advertisement?
questions.question_zh: Tobias 主要使用哪個平台？這與廣告內容有何關聯？
options: Tobias uses Windows, which is not listed in the advertisement.
Tobias uses an iPad, one of the three platforms listed in the advertisement, and wants to confirm the iPad version has full feature parity.
Tobias does not own any of the devices listed in the advertisement.

questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件：廣告列出 PixelForge Suite 支援 Windows、macOS 與 iPad，Tobias 在信中提到自己主要使用 iPad，並詢問功能是否與桌面版相同。

passages.title: Building Notice
paragraphs: Oakwood Corporate Tower will perform scheduled maintenance on Elevators 1 and 2 on February 14 and February 15, from 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. each day. Elevator 3 will remain in service throughout the maintenance period.
Tenants on floors 10 and above are advised to expect longer wait times and are encouraged to use Elevator 3 or the stairwell near the north entrance during peak hours.

Freight deliveries requiring elevator access must be scheduled in advance with building management, as freight use of Elevator 3 will be restricted to before 9:00 a.m. and after 4:00 p.m. on the maintenance days.
For questions, contact management@oakwoodtower.com.

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Dear Building Management,

Thank you for the notice regarding the elevator maintenance on February 14 and 15. Our firm is on floor 14, and we are concerned about a scheduled document delivery from a courier that morning of February 14 at approximately 9:30 a.m.

Since the notice states that freight use of Elevator 3 is restricted to before 9:00 a.m. and after 4:00 p.m. on those days, will our courier be unable to reach our floor at 9:30 a.m.? If so, could you let us know whether an exception can be made, or whether we should reschedule the delivery?

We would also appreciate confirmation of whether Elevator 3 will make stops on floor 14 for regular passenger use during the day, since several of our attorneys have client meetings scheduled that morning.
Thank you, Dana Wexler, Office Manager, Bellamy & Cross Law Firm

questions.question_en: Which elevators will undergo maintenance, according to the notice?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告，哪些電梯將進行維修？
questions.explanation_zh: 公告說明 2 月 14 日與 15 日將對電梯 1 號與 2 號進行維修。

questions.question_en: Which elevator remains available for passenger use throughout the maintenance period?
questions.question_zh: 維修期間，哪部電梯仍可供乘客全程使用？
questions.explanation_zh: 公告指出電梯 3 號在維修期間將持續正常運作。

questions.question_en: What restriction applies to freight deliveries during the maintenance days, according to the notice?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告，維修期間貨運搬運有什麼限制？
options: Freight deliveries are banned entirely during maintenance
Freight use of Elevator 3 is restricted to before 9:00 a.m. and after 4:00 p.m.
Freight can only use the stairwell
questions.explanation_zh: 公告說明維修當天，電梯 3 號僅限於上午 9 點前及下午 4 點後供貨運使用。

questions.question_en: Why is Dana Wexler concerned, according to her e-mail?
questions.question_zh: 根據信件內容，Dana Wexler 為何感到擔憂？
options: Her firm's lease is expiring soon
A courier delivery is scheduled for 9:30 a.m. on February 14, during the restricted freight period
She was not informed about the maintenance at all
Her firm's floor will lose power during maintenance
questions.explanation_zh: Dana 在信中提到公司預計於 2 月 14 日上午 9 點 30 分收到快遞文件，時間恰好落在受限期間內。

questions.question_en: Based on the notice and Dana's e-mail, why might the courier's scheduled delivery time be a problem?
questions.question_zh: 根據公告與 Dana 的信件，為什麼快遞的預定送達時間可能會有問題？
options: 9:30 a.m. falls within the 9:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. freight restriction period.
The courier company is not permitted to enter the building at all.
Elevator 3 will be completely shut down that day.
The delivery was scheduled for the wrong building.
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件：公告限制貨運僅能在上午 9 點前或下午 4 點後使用電梯 3 號，而 Dana 信中提到的送達時間是上午 9 點 30 分，正好落在受限時段內。

questions.question_en: What does Dana Wexler request that goes beyond the information provided in the original notice?
questions.question_zh: Dana Wexler 提出了哪項原公告中未提及的請求？
options: A refund for the maintenance inconvenience
Clarification on whether an exception can be made for their delivery and whether passenger stops on floor 14 will continue
A request to cancel the maintenance entirely
A request to move their office to a lower floor
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件：原公告未說明是否可破例處理個別貨運需求，也未特別說明各樓層的載客服務是否照常，因此 Dana 在信中特別詢問這兩點。

passages.title: Reservation Confirmation
paragraphs: Thank you for reserving a table at Riverside Grill. Your reservation is confirmed for Saturday, July 20 at 7:00 p.m. for a party of six on our outdoor patio.

Please note that Riverside Grill holds patio reservations for 15 minutes past the reservation time. After that, the table may be released to walk-in guests. Cancellations or changes must be made at least 4 hours in advance to avoid a $10 per person fee.
To modify this reservation, reply to this e-mail or call (555) 019-2231.

passages.title: E-mail

meta.label: Subject:
meta.value: Re: Reservation RG-5521 - Need to Change Party Size and Time

paragraphs: Hello Riverside Grill,

I need to make two changes to my reservation, confirmation number RG-5521, for tomorrow evening. First, our party has grown from six to eight guests. Second, two members of our group won't be able to arrive until 7:30 p.m. due to a flight delay.

Would it be possible to update the reservation for 8 guests and move the start time to 7:30 p.m.? I understand this is being requested less than 24 hours in advance, but I wanted to check whether it still falls within your 4-hour change window, since it's currently about 22 hours before the reservation.
Also, since two guests may arrive slightly after 7:30, could the table be held a little longer than the usual 15 minutes in that case?
Thank you for your flexibility, Yolanda Petrov

questions.explanation_zh: 確認單說明戶外座位會保留至訂位時間後 15 分鐘。

questions.question_en: What fee applies to changes made less than 4 hours in advance, according to the confirmation?

options: A 20% surcharge on the final bill
questions.explanation_zh: 確認單指出少於 4 小時前才取消或變更訂位，每人將收取 $10 的費用。

questions.question_en: Why does Yolanda want to change the reservation time to 7:30, according to her e-mail?

options: Two members of her group will be delayed due to a flight delay

The original time was booked in error
questions.explanation_zh: Yolanda 在信中說明，因班機延誤，兩名同行者要到 7:30 才能抵達。

questions.question_en: Based on the confirmation and Yolanda's e-mail, will Yolanda's change request incur the $10 per person fee?
questions.question_zh: 根據確認單與 Yolanda 的信件，她的變更要求是否會產生每人 $10 的費用？
options: Yes, because she is requesting the change fewer than 4 hours in advance.
No, because her request is made about 22 hours in advance, more than the required 4-hour notice.
Yes, because she is increasing the party size.
No, because Riverside Grill does not charge fees for patio reservations.

questions.question_en: What additional accommodation does Yolanda request beyond what the confirmation's standard policy allows?
questions.question_zh: Yolanda 提出了哪項超出確認單標準政策的額外請求？
options: A free dessert for the delay
Holding the table longer than the standard 15 minutes for late-arriving guests
A private room for her party
A discount on the total bill
questions.explanation_zh: 這一題需要同時參考兩篇文件：確認單載明標準保留時間為 15 分鐘，而 Yolanda 在信中額外請求，若部分賓客稍晚抵達，希望能延長保留時間。

passages.title: Property Listing
paragraphs: This charming 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home in Fernwood Heights features a renovated kitchen, hardwood floors throughout, and a fenced backyard ideal for pets. The property is listed at $349,000.

Additional highlights include a two-car garage, a finished basement suitable for a home office or guest suite, and a roof replaced in 2021. The home is within walking distance of Fernwood Elementary School.

Interested buyers may schedule a private showing by contacting listing agent Carla Nunez at carla.nunez@summitridgerealty.com or (555) 340-7788. Open house scheduled for Sunday, April 6, from 1:00 to 3:00 p.m.

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Hi Carla,
I saw the listing for 482 Willowbrook Lane and I'm very interested, but I have a scheduling conflict with the open house on April 6 — I'll be out of town that weekend.

Would it be possible to arrange a private showing sometime during the week of April 7 instead? I'm especially interested in seeing the finished basement, since I work from home and would need a dedicated office space.
Also, could you tell me whether the roof replacement mentioned in the listing came with a warranty, and if so, whether it would transfer to a new owner?
I'm available most weekday evenings after 5:30 p.m. Thank you, Felix Okoro

passages.title: Registration Invoice
paragraphs: Payment received in full on September 20. Cancellations made more than 30 days before the event receive a full refund minus a $50 processing fee. Cancellations made 14-30 days before the event receive a 50% refund. No refunds are issued within 14 days of the event.

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Hello TechSummit Asia Team,

Could you please confirm this amount and let me know how long the refund will take to process? I would also like to ask whether the Workshop Add-on fee is refundable under the same policy, or if it follows separate terms.
Thank you, Grace Lindqvist

questions.question_en: According to the invoice, what refund applies to cancellations made 14-30 days before the event?

questions.question_en: What refund applies to cancellations made more than 30 days in advance, according to the invoice?

The event organizer offered her a special exception

passages.title: Advertisement
paragraphs: Sit better, work better. The ErgoLine ProMesh Chair features adjustable lumbar support, a breathable mesh back, and armrests that adjust in four directions. Built for professionals who spend long hours at a desk.
Available in black, graphite, and navy, the ErgoLine ProMesh is priced at $279 and backed by a 5-year warranty covering the frame, gas lift, and mesh material.
Order online at www.ergolinefurniture.com. Orders placed before 2:00 p.m. ship the same business day. Assembly required; estimated assembly time is 20 minutes.

passages.title: E-mail

meta.label: Subject:
meta.value: Question About ProMesh Chair Weight Limit

paragraphs: Hello,

I'm considering ordering the ErgoLine ProMesh Chair in navy, but I couldn't find the maximum weight capacity listed on your website or in the advertisement. Could you tell me what the weight limit is?

Also, since the ad mentions a 5-year warranty on the frame, gas lift, and mesh, does that warranty cover normal wear and tear, or only manufacturing defects? I want to make sure I understand what would and wouldn't be covered before I order.
Lastly, if I place my order today before 2:00 p.m. as the ad suggests, will it still ship today even though today is a Sunday?
Thank you, Harriet Osei

passages.title: E-mail

meta.label: Subject:
meta.value: Re: Question About ProMesh Chair Weight Limit

paragraphs: Dear Ms. Osei,
Thank you for reaching out. The ErgoLine ProMesh Chair supports up to 300 pounds (136 kg). The navy color you're interested in is currently in stock.
To clarify the warranty: it covers manufacturing defects in the frame, gas lift, and mesh material, but it does not cover normal wear and tear, such as fading fabric or minor scuffs from regular use.

Regarding shipping, our same-day shipping cutoff applies only to business days, Monday through Friday. Since you are ordering on a Sunday, your order would ship the next business day, which would be Monday, January 12.
Please let us know if you have any further questions before placing your order.
Best regards, ErgoLine Customer Support

passages.title: Event Notice

Tickets are $85 for individuals and $150 for couples, and include a three-course dinner and live music. A limited number of sponsor tables for eight guests are available for $900.

We have recorded your meal preference as vegetarian and your guest's as standard. Please note that Cedarbrook Manor requires all meal changes to be submitted no later than October 12, as menus are finalized with the kitchen after that date.
Doors open at 6:00 p.m., and we recommend arriving by 6:15 p.m. for seating, since the three-course dinner service begins promptly at 6:45 p.m.

Warm regards, Green Future Foundation

passages.title: Job Posting
paragraphs: Solstice Analytics is hiring a Data Analyst to support our retail forecasting team. Candidates should have experience with SQL and data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI. A background in retail or e-commerce analytics is a plus but not required.
This is a hybrid role requiring two days per week in our Austin office. The position offers a starting salary range of $62,000-$70,000 depending on experience.
To apply, submit a résumé and cover letter to jobs@solsticeanalytics.com by September 25. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for a first-round phone interview in early October.

passages.title: Cover Letter
paragraphs: Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Data Analyst position at Solstice Analytics. I have three years of experience working as a data analyst for a regional grocery chain, where I used SQL daily to query sales databases and built Power BI dashboards used by store managers across 40 locations.

While my background is primarily in grocery retail rather than e-commerce, I believe my experience forecasting seasonal demand and analyzing inventory trends would transfer well to your retail forecasting team.
I currently live in Austin and would be glad to work in the office two days per week as described in the posting. I am available for a phone interview any weekday morning.
Thank you for your consideration. Sincerely, Andre Kowalski

passages.title: E-mail
paragraphs: Dear Mr. Kowalski,

Thank you for applying for the Data Analyst position. Your experience with Power BI dashboards and sales forecasting stood out to our hiring team, and we would like to invite you for a first-round phone interview.

Please let us know your availability next week, Monday through Friday, between 9:00 a.m. and 12:00 p.m. The interview will last approximately 30 minutes and will be conducted by our team lead, Priya Chandran.
If this goes well, a second-round interview would be held in person at our Austin office, consistent with the hybrid schedule described in the original posting.
We look forward to speaking with you. Best regards, Solstice Analytics Hiring Team
